kiosk.name: 별바다 파크 매표·간식 키오스크
kiosk.domain: theme park / aquarium ticket and snack kiosk (테마파크 매표·간식 키오스크)

flow: Attract screen: brand, '화면을 터치하여 주문을 시작하세요', language toggle 한국어 / English (the only place to change language); tap anywhere else to start
Menu: header with 처음으로, 2+1 banner, category tabs (입장권, 자유이용권, 간식, 음료, 기념품), item card grid, bottom bar (장바구니 count, 합계, 주문하기)

Item option sheet (bottom sheet): tickets = 할인 유형 (some tickets) + 대인/청소년/소인 '− 0 +' steppers; snacks = 추가 선택 (max 2) + 수량; drinks = 사이즈 R/L + 수량 (생수 = 수량 only); 취소 / 담기. 기념품 have no sheet: one tap adds 1 to the cart
Membership popup '회원이신가요?' after the first successful add (once per session): 회원 적립하기 (shows an info message, then 확인) or 비회원으로 계속
Cart drawer sliding in from the right (open by tapping 장바구니 in the bottom bar): lines with − / + (not for tickets or the free line), 삭제 with confirmation, 전체 삭제, 합계, 주문하기
Order review '주문 내역을 확인해 주세요': all lines, 상품 N건, 총 결제 금액; 이전 / 결제하기
Payment method screen '결제 수단을 선택해 주세요': 결제하실 금액 and 신용/체크카드, 간편결제 (QR·바코드), 모바일 상품권; choosing one asks for confirmation and then shows a practice notice (end; no real payment)

discount.title: 할인 유형
discount.appliesWhen: only on 아쿠아리움 입장권, 아쿠아리움+전망대 패키지, 종일 자유이용권, 오후 자유이용권. priceDelta is per person and applies to every person on the line. 경로 우대 allows 대인 only (청소년/소인 steppers are disabled and reset to 0). Adding without a choice shows '할인 유형을 선택해 주세요.'

age_aquarium.appliesWhen: 아쿠아리움 입장권 only; per-person price = basePrice + priceDelta (+ discount delta)

age_skydeck.appliesWhen: 오션 스카이 전망대 only; per-person price = basePrice + priceDelta

age_package.appliesWhen: 아쿠아리움+전망대 패키지 only; per-person price = basePrice + priceDelta (+ discount delta)

age_4d.appliesWhen: 4D 해저탐험 영상관 only; per-person price = basePrice + priceDelta

topping.title: 추가 선택 (최대 2개)
topping.appliesWhen: all 간식 items; picking a 3rd shows '추가 선택은 최대 2개까지 가능합니다.' and is not selected

size.title: 사이즈
size.appliesWhen: all 음료 except 생수 500ml; R is preselected

promotions.rule: 별사탕 츄러스 2+1: for every 2 paid 별사탕 츄러스 in the cart (summed across all its lines, any 추가 선택), 1 more is free. Free count = floor(paid qty / 2).
promotions.effect: The kiosk adds or updates one separate line '별사탕 츄러스' with option text '2+1 증정', qty = free count, price 0원, no add-ons, placed at the end of the cart. It has no − / + or 삭제; it changes or disappears when the paid churros change. The total is unchanged by the free line.

patterns: quick-add souvenirs (tap adds 1, repeat tap merges)
sold-out (해파리 무드등 is asked for but cannot be added; skip it)
sold-out (고래 꼬리 핫도그 is asked for but cannot be added; skip it)

quirks: Notation: for 'quantity' option groups (age_*), each option id appears once per person, e.g. ["adult","adult","child"] = 대인 2, 소인 1. A ticket sheet becomes ONE cart line (qty 1) whose price is the sum over persons of (basePrice + age priceDelta + discount priceDelta).

Extra holdout fields: 'language' = which language to pick on the attract screen; 'autoLines' = lines the kiosk adds by itself (2+1 free line, 0원); 'requestedButSoldOut' = items a customer asks for that are sold out and must be left out (expectedTotal excludes them).
Language can be changed only on the attract screen. 처음으로 (after a confirmation when the cart is not empty) clears the cart and resets the language to 한국어.
Prices are shown as '4,500원' in English mode too. English labels: Adult/Youth/Child, Standard/Disability/Senior (65+), R Regular/L Large.
Ticket cards show only the 대인 price, e.g. '대인 29,000원'. The sheet shows each age's per-person price, updated after a discount type is picked (e.g. 장애인 우대 → 대인 19,000원).

Discount tickets: steppers work before a discount type is chosen, but 담기 shows '할인 유형을 선택해 주세요.' Choosing 경로 우대 disables 청소년/소인 and resets them to 0 with a red notice. 담기 with 0 persons shows '인원을 1명 이상 선택해 주세요.' Max 9 per age.
Ticket lines cannot change quantity in the cart drawer (shows 'N명'); delete and re-add instead.
기념품 have no option sheet: one tap adds 1 and shows a toast '장바구니에 담았습니다.'; tapping again raises that line's qty.
Adding the same non-ticket item with the same options merges into the existing line (qty adds up). Different add-ons or sizes make separate lines.
Drinks: R is preselected; L is +1,000원. 생수 500ml has no size, only 수량.
Snack add-ons are optional checkbox-like tiles (divs); a 3rd pick shows '추가 선택은 최대 2개까지 가능합니다.' and is ignored.
The 2+1 free churros line appears at the end of the cart with a '증정' badge, 0원, no 삭제; adding churros that create a free one shows a toast about the free item instead of '장바구니에 담았습니다.'.
The banner text '별사탕 츄러스 2+1 행사 중!' also contains the item name, so a plain text match on '별사탕 츄러스' can hit the banner instead of the card.
Sold-out cards (고래 꼬리 핫도그, 해파리 무드등) are greyed with a '품절' overlay; tapping them opens an error popup '품절된 상품입니다. 다른 상품을 선택해 주세요.' with 확인.

The membership popup '회원이신가요?' appears once, right after the first successful add, and blocks the screen. '비회원으로 계속' is an underlined text link (a div), '회원 적립하기' is a button that shows an info popup needing 확인. Neither changes prices.
The cart drawer opens only from the 장바구니 area in the bottom bar (left side); 주문하기 in the bottom bar goes straight to the review screen. Tapping the dark backdrop or ✕ closes the drawer.
Deleting a line asks '선택한 상품을 장바구니에서 삭제할까요?' (취소 / 삭제). 전체 삭제 and 처음으로 also confirm. 주문하기 with an empty cart shows an error popup.
The bottom-bar badge counts persons for ticket lines and qty for other lines (the free line counts too); the review screen shows '상품 N건' = number of lines.
DOM text merges: a card's text reads like '2+1⭐별사탕 츄러스4,500원' or '품절' + name; the cart bar reads '장바구니3'; a line name and its options read '아쿠아리움 입장권장애인 우대 / 대인 1명 · 소인 1명'.
Toasts stay until the next tap (no timers). The payment screen shows the final amount in '결제하실 금액'; choosing a method asks '…(으)로 결제를 진행할까요?' and then only shows '연습용 키오스크입니다. 실제 결제는 진행되지 않습니다.'
